programs.title: Shalimar
programs.desc: Kumar, a thief, aspires to be mafia boss Sir John's successor by stealing Shalimar, a priceless diamond. Adamant to succeed in his mission, Kumar must overcome many tribulations to seize the diamond.

programs.title: Anari
programs.desc: The film follows Raja and Poonam, a young couple whose romance is strained by extreme poverty, family responsibilities, and a tempting, immoral job offer, putting their love and moral compass to the test

programs.title: Tum Haseen Main Jawan
programs.desc: A navy officer who has had a number of affairs with attractive young women meets a beautiful girl and falls in love. Though she loves him in return, another admirer of hers tells the officer that she is deceiving him and is the mother of a child.
